I tried both, and the automatic one feels more natural to me. In that version I paste the link and the title and description just appear on their own for me to tweak — it's one smooth motion. The guided version made me press an extra "Get details" button first before I could touch anything, which felt like a step that didn't need to be there. So let's go with the automatic version.

And yes, the division is right: letting me change the title and the description is exactly what I wanted, and it makes sense that the site name, its little icon, and the web address stay tied to the actual page — those are the page's own identity, not something I'd want to rewrite. Being able to fix up the wording while I'm saving, and knowing I can also come back and adjust it later, covers what I was worried about.

This part's good — let's keep building.
